text: 据伊朗迈赫尔通讯社报道，伊朗议会议长卡利巴夫已将《国家人工智能发展法》提交总统执行。该法包含12条和8项附注，其报告由工业与矿业委员会提交议会全体会议，经公开会议通过后获宪法监护委员会批准。根据该法案第2条，为组织和发展人工智能生态系统，将成立国家人工智能组织，作为独立机构和全国指导委员会秘书处，仅使用现有设施、预算和人力，并遵守相关法律法规，在总统领导下运作。
text_en: According to Iran's Mehr News Agency, Iranian Parliament Speaker Qalibaf has submitted the "National Artificial Intelligence Development Law" to the president for implementation. The law contains 12 articles and 8 notes, and its report was submitted by the Industry and Mines Committee to the parliament's plenary session, passed in a public session, and then approved by the Guardian Council. According to Article 2 of the bill, in order to organize and develop the artificial intelligence ecosystem, a National Artificial Intelligence Organization will be established as an independent body and the secretariat of the national steering committee, using only existing facilities, budgets, and personnel, and complying with relevant laws and regulations, operating under the leadership of the president.
